summary: A capped Card.Body that scrolls is now a tab stop: a region named by the card's title, with an inset focus outline, so static content past the cap can be scrolled from the keyboard (SC 2.1.1). It is a tab stop only while it actually overflows, which is Sheet.Body's and Table's rule. Found by CI rather than locally: Linux fonts set the States story a few pixels taller than macOS, and only there did the body overflow and axe report scrollable-region-focusable.
